title: Services - BaSuka Energy
metaDescription: BaSuka Energy services: 130 MW generation foundation, SIRA battery swapping, solar-first Swap & Glow stations, EV mobility infrastructure, and household power — women-led in Africa.

sections.heading: Energy Generation & Infrastructure for Africa
sections.body: BaSuka is developing a professional, women-led energy platform built on four utility-scale power plants delivering 130 MW of new dispatchable capacity. This reliable generation foundation will support the national grid, industry, mining, agriculture, water infrastructure, businesses, homes, and future energy services.

sections.heading: Future Storage & Swappable-Battery Services
sections.intro: Once dependable generation is established, BaSuka will extend the platform through standardized storage and swappable-battery services.

items.title: The 60-Second Swap
items.body: Our stations allow riders to exchange a depleted battery for a fully charged one in less time than it takes to refuel a petrol bike.

items.title: The DMS Standard
items.body: We utilize a universal battery format. This “EV-agnostic” approach means any manufacturer or fleet that adopts the DMS standard can utilize our network without proprietary lock-in

items.title: Smart BMS Monitoring
items.body: Every battery is equipped with an integrated Battery Management System (BMS) that tracks health, temperature, and cycles in real-time to ensure maximum safety.

sections.heading: Integrated Energy Hubs
sections.intro: Future energy hubs will connect storage, smart services, and clean mobility to the dependable generation foundation.

items.title: Off-Grid Reliability
items.body: Every station is equipped with a high-capacity solar array and on-site energy storage, ensuring 95% uptime regardless of the local grid’s stability.

items.title: Sustainable Generation
items.body: By generating 100% of our station power from the sun, we provide a clean, carbon-light fuel source for the transport sector

items.title: Dual Charging Options
items.body: While swapping is our primary focus, our hubs also feature conventional charging points for vehicles suited for stationary plug-in charging

sections.heading: Community Energy Services
sections.intro: Beyond mobility, our stations serve as safe, reliable community hubs managed by certified local women

items.title: Ancillary Services
items.body: Customers can access essential services such as phone charging and small retail at our station locations

items.title: Professional Management:
items.body: Every station is operated by a graduate of the BaSuka Academy, ensuring high-quality customer service and technical expertise

sections.heading: BaSuka Academy: Professional Operations
sections.intro: We provide “Infrastructure-as-a-Service” by ensuring every site is managed by a certified professional.

items.title: Talent Pipeline
items.body: The Academy trains women to become “Infrastructure Managers,” covering technical maintenance, solar management, and digital point-of-sale (POS) systems.

items.title: Professional Standards
items.body: This ensures that fleet partners and individual riders receive consistent, high-quality, and safe service at every BaSuka location

sections.heading: Fleet & B2B Solutions
sections.intro: We offer specialized energy management for commercial partners, including logistics firms, delivery companies, and moto-taxi cooperatives.

items.title: Predictable Energy Costs
items.body: We offer subscription-based models and volume agreements that allow businesses to lock in their energy expenses and avoid petrol price volatility.

items.title: Data Transparency
items.body: Partners receive access to our data platform, providing insights into their fleet’s energy consumption, battery health, and operational efficiency

sections.heading: Join BaSuka's integrated energy platform
sections.body: BaSuka welcomes partners in fuel, technology, engineering, financing, workforce development, and the public sector to help deliver dependable power and the services it enables.

sections.heading: Energy for Infrastructure, Water & Agriculture
sections.intro: Our 130 MW generation foundation powers more than mobility — it enables the critical infrastructure that drives national development.

items.title: Grid Reliability & Industry
items.body: Dispatchable baseload power for mining operations, agro-processing facilities, manufacturing, and commercial enterprises that depend on uninterrupted electricity.

items.title: Water Infrastructure
items.body: Reliable power for water treatment plants, pumping stations, and irrigation systems — ensuring clean water access and agricultural productivity.

items.title: Agricultural Productivity
items.body: Electricity for cold storage, grain milling, food processing, and farm equipment — reducing post-harvest losses and powering the agricultural value chain.
